title: SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion
tagline: Immersive player thoughts for game events, status changes, and supported mods.
description:
SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion is an SKSE plugin that turns game events,
status changes, notifications, and events from supported mods into immersive
SkyrimNet player thoughts. (ASDF)

This Hub entry links to the complete mod download. The full mod is required
because it contains the native SKSE DLL, ESP, Papyrus scripts, configuration,
and SkyrimNet trigger definitions.

Download and install the latest release with your mod manager.

List of mods that may benefit to varying degrees from the plugin and where to find them:
YPS fashion mod: YPS thoughts piped to SkyrimNet, YPS heels and feet training status and slowdown effects, comments on activation of clothing with YPS keywords, ( Recommended setting for this one: Turn off the in-build thought volume to zero, so that you don't have like an echo of the original sound sample from YPS and the player-thought voice from SkyrimNet. Also, reduce the default frequency of thoughts, so that they integrate well with the higher chatter frequency from SkyrimNet. I use a setting of 4 percent probability per frame on 60 fps myself.
MME Milk mod: Full milk, halfway full, empty, lactacid level rise, milk pump usage, maid level rise, (
Advanced Nudity Detection (AND) mod: Change of (partial) nudity state, (
SLSF: Major changes of fame,
Battlefuck: Start of struggle comments,
FINISHED in 0.6.3: Support for BodySearch mod,
Unforgiving Devices / Unforgiving Skyrim: Application and removal of certain devices,
Devious Followers,
SLAC: Start of scenes and end of scenes,
SL Survival 0.685 Beta SE: barefoot effect,
STA v4.8 BETA SE: run-up-and-spank mod broadcast,
The Ancient Profession: Generic freelance work scene.
Some basic support for Jailrape mod.
Some basic support for Licenses - Player Oppression mod.
Some basic support for the SE Version of the Apropos 2 mod,
Vanilla Skyrim: disease application and cure (partial, only stomach rot disease so far).
Vanilla Skyrim: furniture use, now with a furniture-type specific cooldown (0.6.6).
author: johnsonjoe1
changelog: This version migrated to CommonLibSSE-NG 0.9.1, which *should* bring compatibility with SkyrimVR as well as Skyrim 1.7.104 (in addition of course to support for Skyrim 1.6.1170, the main development version).  The other versions are *UNTESTED* thought, so feedback on that is very wellcome.
